name: launch-window
about: The launch window with NO network: nothing here joins or connects. Connect is never pressed.

params.app: path to a ducktape-app binary (the door ships in every build; it opens only with DUCKTAPE_AX_DOOR)

steps.say: start the app on a fresh home with no network
the launch window offers Join with invitation
the launch window names its screen: Your networks
type the address 127.0.0.1:9 into the Remote node address field
steps.expect: the Remote node address field holds 127.0.0.1:9 and the Connect button is enabled (it no longer reports disabled)

steps.say: clear the Remote node address field by setting its value to empty text
steps.expect: the Remote node address field is empty and the Connect button reports disabled
the invitation screen shows: an Invitation field and a Join network button

steps.say: go back to the networks list
steps.expect: the launch window again shows the Remote node address field and Join with invitation
